Close the OLTC cover and vent the cover. If the OLTC is

Check by hand crank the switching of mechanical and

 general condition.

Make test operations by hand first then make test
 operations with electrical drive.
Grease necessary parts of motor drive if necessary.
Open berel gear and check it visually.

Check drive shafts and coupling visually and grease them
 if necessary.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
We recommend a periodic inspection of the tap changer equipment
to certain a high reliability in service according to manufacture instructions.
The major maintenance procedures P1
should be carried out every five years Y5
We recommend that personnel well acquainted with the equipment
should carry out the inspection. The Inspection should be carried out as quickly
as possible with the most care and tidiness.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Caution marks in control room is required
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.... etc
The high village CB and voltage CB peeper earthling is inquired
Use fiber glass ladders
Tools and Equipment
Oil littering machine with tank, hoses and flushing pipe,
Mobile crane
Empty oil barrels and pails for flushing oil
Oil dielectric tester and oil sample bottles, Multi metes
One set of socket wrenches screwdrivers
The special tools for the tap lap changes,
New oil
Proper plastic garbage bag to catch oil drips
Rubber gloves, Small brushes, Cloth wipes
Spare pasts contacts bolts washers gasket cover glue.
Proper steel tray to wash the diverter with oil in. it.
Work to be Carried Out
1 | Drive on Load tapchanger type SAV 220/1600-3-12/1 to the
 adjusting position (position 4)
2 | Drain the oil from the oil compartment of the OLTC
3 | Open the OLTC cover.
4 | Loosen the holding screws of the upper rim of the internal
 cylinder.
5 | Lift the diverter switch, insert by using the existing
 lifting eyes.
6 | The diverter switch insert exists of the insolating
 cylinder with transition resistors and the diverter switch.
 Disconnect the insulating cylinder from the diverter. Switch after
 loosen the screws of the connection between insulating cylinder and
 diverter switch.
 Lift the insulating cylinder.

 Clean the parts with soft clothes on brushes.
8 | Check the diverter switch
 All contacts tightened, check by trying to move them by hand.

 at their fixing points

 Switch the diverter switch in both operating position for doing this
 check but remember the position your hair dismount the diverter switch
 from the oil compartment.
 Check the contacts for the resistor connection.

 contacts.

16 | Fill new transformer oil into the oil compartment and

17 | Close the OLTC cover and vent the cover. If the OLTC is

 1- Check safety diagram visually.
 2- Check functions of protective relay (flow relay).
Motor drive inspection
1 | Check coupling of motor drive and OLTC, it should be
 symmetrically.
2 | Check by hand crank the switching of mechanical and
 electrical and position.
3 | Check contractors, breakers, housing sealing, terminals
 general condition.
4 | Make test operations by hand first then make test
 operations with electrical drive.
5 | Grease necessary parts of motor drive if necessary.
Drive shaft, Berel gear
1 | Open berel gear and check it visually.
2 | Grease ports if necessary.
3 | Check drive shafts and coupling visually and grease them
 if necessary.

The diverter switch should not be without oil more than 10
hours.
